findings.text: follow-on: the fix pins the probe seam but leaves no committed guard — removing the two probe_reader pins leaves the file green on a host whose codex login does not answer, which baseline-suite.log shows as 37 passed at base, so a regression to host-dependence would not redden in the routine suite; the node's own driver proves a committed regression test is feasible.

follow-on: the answering-probe driver the done-when rests on (answering_probe_driver.py) exists only under node-local /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch, so the reproduction cannot be re-run from the run record once that scratch dies; only the log's command line and result are preserved.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 3fd34363; the single commit adds the two probe_reader pins and no product source; the file is clean at head 996ee1812.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names the one id passing with a simulated answering probe (gate-answering.log: 1 passed, EXIT=0) and without a driver (gate-plain.log: 1 passed, EXIT=0) plus the whole file (gate-file.log: 37 passed in 56.42 s, EXIT=0), each headed with the head revision, module.__file__ and cwd.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that the stamp test asserts the record stamp whatever the host's codex login answers; the diff adds probe_reader=lambda backend, settings: None to both crew_lanes_view calls (tests/test_preflight_pace.py:1433 and :1443) and reckon/mcp_views.py:741-750 adopts that reader so a None answer leaves the lane dated by _receipt_observed_at(run), the record stamp.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, one commit 996ee1812, arms recorded with revision headers; its baseline_suite and after_suite are both the plain non-answering arms, both 37 passed, so the structured suite delta is zero and the reproduction lives only in the scratch-driver logs.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's three declared paths; the diff touches only tests/test_preflight_pace.py, and the fragment and figure paths are correctly left unwritten for a small node whose done-when names no artifact.

justifications.durability: the change is test-only and no committed test reddens if the two pins are reverted on a host whose codex probe does not answer (baseline-suite.log shows the file green at base, 37 passed), so the regression the node fixes is guarded only by a scratch driver rather than by a committed test.
justifications.evidence: the gate arms are recorded with revision, module.__file__ and cwd and end in EXIT lines, but the two structured suite arms (baseline-suite.log, gate-file.log) are both green 37 passed so they carry no signal about the defect, and the answering-probe reproduction instrument (answering_probe_driver.py) survives only in node-local /tmp scratch.
justifications.fit: the injected probe_reader=lambda backend, settings: None matches the idiom already used in tests/test_lanes_view_is_live.py:223 and tests/test_crew_lanes_view.py:501, the subject is conventional with a body, and no forbidden name is introduced.
